title: Enterprise Connectivity: committed line capacity
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following committed line capacity for each named contract tier. Private interconnect committed line capacity; Mbps integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | committed line capacity | 100 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | committed line capacity | 250 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | committed line capacity | 500 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | committed line capacity | 1000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | committed line capacity | 2000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | committed line capacity | 5000 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the committed line capacity is 100.
